Metadata.title: Pousada Dona Marta | Pinheira Beach, Palhoça - Brazil
Metadata.description: Just 100 meters from Pinheira Beach. Fully equipped accommodations, warm hospitality and the tranquility of the Santa Catarina coast. Book your stay at Pousada Dona Marta.

Hero.badge: Enseada da Pinheira · Santa Catarina, Brazil
Hero.subtitle: Modern comfort and the calm of the Santa Catarina coast, 100 meters from the sand at Pinheira Beach.

About.title: More than a place to stay
About.paragraph1: Founded with love more than 30 years ago on Pinheira Beach, Pousada Dona Marta is part of the story of this place — and of our own family. Over the years, we've watched guests become friends who return year after year.
About.paragraph2: Today we blend modern comfort with the simplicity of coastal life, warm hospitality and our own organic garden, in a setting designed for families and anyone looking for true rest — just steps from the sea.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking.

items.question: Do you accept pets?
items.answer: Yes, we accept small pets with advance notice at the time of booking. We just ask for care with the furniture and respect for common areas — any damage is the guest's responsibility.

items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in from 2pm and check-out by 11am. Need an early arrival or late departure? Check availability with us before booking.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: Yes. We offer free on-site parking, in a gated area with an electronic gate.

items.question: Do you offer daily housekeeping?
items.answer: We don't offer daily housekeeping during your stay. A full cleaning is done before each guest's arrival.

items.question: How does the booking and cancellation policy work?
items.answer: Your booking is confirmed with an advance payment, agreed at the time of booking. Late cancellations or no-shows may result in the paid amount being withheld — get in touch to check the conditions before cancelling.
